question.latex: The worst-case time complexity of QuickSort on an array of $n$ elements is:
question.unicode: The worst-case time complexity of QuickSort on an array of n elements is:
question.plainText: The worst-case time complexity of QuickSort on an array of n elements is:

explanation.latex: Worst case occurs when the pivot chosen is always the smallest or largest element (e.g. already sorted array), yielding $T(n) = T(n-1) + \mathcal{O}(n) = \mathcal{O}(n^2)$.
explanation.unicode: Worst case occurs when the pivot chosen is always the smallest or largest element (e.g. already sorted array), yielding T(n) = T(n-1) + mathcal{O}(n) = mathcal{O}(n²).
